Questions & Concerns
If you have used one of our products and have a question or concern, we would like to speak to you directly.
By contacting L’Oréal Paris, whether by phone, email, or chat, I agree to L’Oréal Paris’s Terms of Use (which includes an arbitration provision to resolve disputes), and I have read and acknowledge L’Oréal Paris’s Privacy Policy. Phone calls, chats, or emails with Us are recorded, stored, and accessible to Our third-party service provider(s). We leverage technologies provided by Our third-party service provider(s), including artificial intelligence, in responding to You. We leverage these technologies to, amongst other reasons, to identify and classify the reason You reach out to Us, to help Our customer service agents identify solutions to Your inquiry, and to help Our customer service agents prepare a response to You and other reasons listed in our Privacy Policy.
Call Us
| Phone: 1-800-322-2036 For Hair Color inquiries, please call 1-833-856-7325 Monday - Friday 9:00 AM - 5:30 PM ET | 
Ask Us Anything
If you have a question about makeup, hair, skin care, samples, coupons, or if you are experiencing problems with our site, let us know.
Submit your question
At L’Oréal, we care about your privacy. If you have questions or concerns about how we use your information, you may review U.S. Privacy Policy, terms of Use and Notice of Financial Incentives here. Non-US consumers should visit the country website serving their region.
| Job Opportunities | Stay Connected |
